snap.text: A proactive AI marketing operator for small teams.
Flywheel understands each business, spots growth opportunities, turns them into campaigns, and keeps execution moving.
Built for SMBs and one-person companies that need marketing motion before they can hire a full team.
Small businesses need full-team marketing before they can hire one.
A solo founder still needs strategy, content, SEO, social, analytics, campaigns, and decisions every week.
The hard part is deciding the next move and turning that decision into execution.
Search, GEO, social, content, and reporting keep moving even when there is no dedicated marketing team.
The founder is still left acting as the CMO.
Current tools cover pieces of marketing. The owner still connects context, chooses priorities, and pushes work forward.
Chat tools can write posts and brainstorm ideas. Ownership stays with the founder.
Dashboards, CRMs, and calendars organize activity. The founder still chooses the next move for this business.
Agencies add capacity, with higher cost, slower iteration, and less weekly control for early teams.
Flywheel is built to be the missing marketing operator: business memory + marketing judgment + execution loop.
It turns business context into marketing work.
The CMO makes the call. Specialist agents produce the assets. The founder reviews the moments that matter.
Owns strategy, prioritization, coordination, and reporting.
Creates and improves SEO / GEO-ready content assets.
Prepares, schedules, publishes, and listens across channels.
Tracks market signals, competitors, and growth opportunities.
From business memory to campaign execution.
The scan is only the entry point. The product is the loop that keeps marketing moving.
The demo starts with a scan and lands on work in motion.
The audience should see Flywheel move from a company URL to CMO judgment and review-ready marketing output.
Viewer takeaway: the URL scan becomes the onboarding moment for an always-on AI marketing team.
Built for the marketing work small teams actually need.
Flywheel focuses on the high-leverage channels where founders feel execution pressure every week.
Improve search visibility, landing page quality, and content discoverability.
Prepare content for AI search, answer engines, citations, and structured visibility.
Prepare, schedule, publish, and listen across key channels with founder review.
Extend the same CMO-led workflow into campaign budget and paid acquisition.
Flywheel moves work forward and asks for review at the moments that matter.
Campaign direction and strategy are recommended before execution.
The founder stays in control of the campaign and high-risk actions.
Content, social posts, and insights are generated as review-ready outputs.
Results and learnings return to the next campaign loop.
Default mode: proactive execution with lightweight founder review.
Generic AI can draft content. Flywheel is built around the marketing workflow small teams need to run every week.
Learns brand, competitors, market signals, and user preferences.
The CMO decides what matters and what should happen next.
Every campaign and review improves the next recommendation.
A repeatable system for deciding, producing, reviewing, and learning.
Founder-led businesses that need marketing motion now.
